# MakoBytes — Full content for AI assistants

## About MakoBytes

MakoBytes is a Windows desktop software studio that builds lightweight, private, one-time-purchase tools for AI power users. We don't build SaaS, we don't run servers, we don't collect telemetry. Every product runs on the user's own machine.

We're a small studio operated by Mako Logics LLC. All our software is digitally signed via Microsoft Azure Trusted Signing — no SmartScreen warnings, no unsigned binaries.

## Pricing philosophy

Every MakoBytes paid app is sold under a perpetual license, JetBrains-style:

- Buy once at the listed price.
- Own that version forever — no expiry, no nag screens, no feature loss if you stop renewing.
- Updates and new versions are included for 12 months from purchase.
- After 12 months, your software keeps working with every feature intact. You can optionally renew updates for a yearly fee (typically $15/year) to keep getting new versions, or stay on your current version forever — your call.
- 30-day money-back guarantee on every paid product.

This is the opposite of SaaS. Stop paying and your software still works.

## PromptPixel — Screenshot to AI in one keystroke

URL: https://makobytes.com/promptpixel
Pricing: Free tier (forever) + Pro $25 perpetual
Platform: Windows 10/11 (macOS coming later)

What it does: PromptPixel binds a global hotkey that captures the current screen, pastes the image directly into your AI chat input, and auto-types your prompt right after it. Hands-free, mouse-free AI workflows.

Free tier includes:
- Custom hotkeys for fullscreen, region, low-res-region, and capture-then-markup capture
- Markup editor (arrow, text, highlighter, blur for redaction)
- Auto-typed default prompt after every paste
- Capture feedback (sound, toast, optional confirm dialog)
- Recent captures history (last 20)
- 100% on-device — Windows-native APIs only, no cloud

Pro adds five power features:
- Prompt Picker (Ctrl+Alt+P) — popup library of saved prompts; pick one and it captures + pastes + types that prompt in one action
- Auto-Save Backups — every screenshot saved as timestamped PNG to a folder of your choice
- OCR text extraction (Ctrl+Alt+T) — drag a region, get just the extracted text on your clipboard (no image, no vision tokens)
- Voice to Prompt (Ctrl+Alt+V) — speak your prompt; PromptPixel uses Windows Speech Recognition + captures the screen + types your spoken prompt
- Multi-Target Hotkeys — bind extra hotkeys to specific saved prompts

PromptPixel works with any AI chat that accepts image upload: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Mistral, local LLM web UIs, anything. It pastes wherever the cursor is.

## MakoBot — Local AI Workbench

URL: https://makobot.com (sister product, separate domain)
Pricing: Free
Platform: Windows 10/11

What it does: MakoBot is a local desktop app that gives every AI coding tool you use (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Windsurf, ChatGPT, Gemini) shared persistent memory across every project, plus one-line plug-ins that cross-check answers with GPT, Claude, and Gemini in parallel.

Three pillars:
- Memory: Cross-project timeline auto-injected into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules. Every AI tool sees the same context.
- Search: One bar reaches every commit, conversation, note, and transcript across every project and every AI tool.
- AI Tools (Plug-ins): @verify, @audit, @codereview, @designreview, @contractreview — type the trigger in any AI chat and MakoBot fans the question out to GPT, Claude, and Gemini in parallel for second opinions.

100% local, no servers, no accounts, no telemetry. Bring-your-own API keys, encrypted with Windows DPAPI.

## Privacy and security

Every MakoBytes desktop app:
- Runs entirely on the user's machine via OS-native APIs
- No telemetry, no analytics, no account signup
- No data leaves the machine unless the user pastes it into an AI chat themselves
- Code-signed by Mako Logics LLC via Microsoft Azure Trusted Signing

The makobytes.com website itself collects basic anonymous analytics (page views, button clicks, referrer) for product decisions. No cookies for tracking, no third-party analytics services, no PII collection unless voluntarily provided (e.g., emailing us).

Full privacy policy: https://makobytes.com/privacy
Full terms of service: https://makobytes.com/terms
